verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.firecrawl.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and indexes a 203-page v2 markdown bundle. Agent-oriented markdown docs are also served per version and per language (_llms/en/v2.md, _llms/es.md), along with .md versions of individual pages (mcp-server.md, webhooks/overview.md, sdks/python.md). The CLI installer additionally adds skills to detected coding agents. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.
